headline.label: Held out, read once
headline.note: The held-out splits as recorded once, each with the code and prompts of its day, pooled and re-analysed with the final run's statistics after their results were known.

methods.published_ci: the scorer's interval as docs/evals.md publishes it: a percentile bootstrap over letters, a Wilson interval over letters at a rate of 0 or 1
methods.paired_one_read: exact McNemar (two-sided) on the discordant pairs, mid-p beside it; Bonett-Price interval
methods.paired_clustered: sign-flip test over letter clusters (exact up to 20 non-zero clusters, else 100000 seeded draws); paired cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, percentile interval
methods.verdict: clear: Holm-adjusted mid-p below 0.05 and the Bonett-Price interval excludes 0; suggestive: the unadjusted mid-p below 0.05; else no clear difference
methods.tiers: please_check: low confidence, Please check, or found without a date; second_look: medium confidence; none: no flag, or missed
methods.aurc: risk-coverage from the most confident tier down, errors spread evenly within a tier
methods.loss: per 100 scored items: early + r * harmful
methods.crossover: r at which the losses are equal; letter-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, percentile interval (null: never)

rules_text_claim.text: 14 vs 5 discordant, exact p 0.064 (mid-p 0.041, Holm 0.083): suggestive, not settled

rules_text_crossover.text: Ordnung's harm-weighted loss is the lower one until a late or missed date costs 5.5 early ones (95 % bootstrap range 1.3 to never)
